bibl.title: Psalm 9.22-26 in a 4th-Century Papyrus from the Western Desert in Egypt.
bibl.seg: Klaas A. Worp, Psalm 9.22-26 in a 4th-Century Papyrus from the Western Desert in Egypt.
bibl.note: P. Kellis Inv. P97.44, found during the 1997 season in excavation area D/8, Room 8, level 4, Group on left, just outside the outer temenos to the North of the main temple of the village. - Recto: Psalm 9.22,2-26,2 (4th cent. CE). - Verso (described): a fragmentarily preserved and much faded documentary text (a letter?).
